subject: typography
text: - The seven_guis headless stand's font registration is held in architecture §Standard Contracts → Headless stand, beside `font_ctx()`, not as a design-system typography value

subject: typography
text: - A custom `FontContext` can be set; on WASM a context with bundled fonts must be provided, using `build_single_font_ctx` for one font (packages/dioxus-native/src/config.rs:56-64); `build_single_font_ctx` registers one font as fallback for SansSerif, Serif, Monospace and SystemUi with system fonts disabled (packages/blitz-dom/src/lib.rs:134-165)

subject: typography
text: - Font features: system-fonts, woff, complex-scripts (dictionary line-breaking), font-embolden and apple-font-embolden (packages/dioxus-native/Cargo.toml:20-25; packages/dioxus-native/Cargo.toml:47-48)

subject: typography
text: - A bullet font is always registered in the default font context (packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:440-442; packages/blitz-dom/src/lib.rs:32)

subject: typography
text: - Since 2026-10-12-headless-screenshot a driver `screenshot` of an app whose font context resolves no `sans-serif` family (`BaseDocument::can_paint_text` false) is refused `fonts-unavailable` with nothing painted — a shot never paints text skipped; the stand's bundled font passes the check (packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:1134-1147; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-12-headless-screenshot/report.md)

subject: typography
text: - `document.fonts` is a stub FontFaceSet where all fonts report as loaded (packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/runtime.rs:1060-1074)

subject: typography
text: - `blitz-dom` is built with the `system-fonts` feature for the blitz-tests crate; without it text measures 0x0 and font-dependent assertions pass vacuously, and the feature is stated to be enabled by default when testing the whole workspace (tests/blitz-tests/Cargo.toml:17; tests/blitz-tests/tests/br_trailing_line.rs:11-13; tests/blitz-tests/tests/inline_box_baseline.rs:4-6)

subject: typography
text: - Generic font families map to Parley generics, with `None` as sans-serif (packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo_to_parley.rs:50-60)

subject: typography
text: - Font weight, width, style and variation settings convert to Parley values (packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo_to_parley.rs:87-112)

subject: typography
text: - Line height maps `normal`, number and length to Parley line heights (packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo_to_parley.rs:407-412); the layout engine resolves `line-height: normal` as 1.2 × font size (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/mod.rs:232-236)

subject: typography
text: - Text locale comes from the computed `_x_lang` value, which the `lang` attribute sets (packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo_to_parley.rs:495; packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo.rs:1201-1203)

subject: typography
text: - `text-align` and `text-align-last` map to Parley alignment (packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo_to_parley.rs:304-329); word break, line break, overflow wrap, wrap mode and white-space collapse map to Parley settings (packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo_to_parley.rs:331-346; packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo_to_parley.rs:467-484)

subject: typography
text: - The new stylist device is seeded with the root element's font size and line height so rem/rlh units do not fall back to the 16px default (packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:2322-2343); `rem` resolves against the root font-size after viewport and hidpi changes, with an initial root font-size of 16px (tests/blitz-tests/tests/rem_after_viewport_change.rs:1-8; tests/blitz-tests/tests/rem_after_viewport_change.rs:49-77)
